sentences.quote: Ridgeline Value Fund IV is the fourth vintage in Ridgeline Capital's diversified value-add series, targeting the acquisition and repositioning of multifamily and mixed-use assets in supply-constrained coastal and Mountain-West metros.
sentences.text: Ridgeline Value Fund IV is a closed-end diversified value-add fund that targets the acquisition and repositioning of multifamily and mixed-use assets in supply-constrained coastal and Mountain-West metros.

sentences.quote: The strategy emphasizes operational improvement, unit renovation, and mark-to-market of below-market rents, with selective ground-up completion.
sentences.text: The strategy emphasizes operational improvement, unit renovation and the mark-to-market of below-market rents, with selective ground-up completion.
